title: Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.02491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about

translated_title: 相同的句子，不同的构念：身份互换的推理揭示LLM仇恨言论分类器中的测量非不变性
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作测量仇恨言论等具有重大社会影响的构念的测量工具，且通常通过其与人类标签的总体一致率来进行验证。然而，一个有效的测量工具必须对其所测量的每一个群体应用相同的构念。我们使用421个模板对这一要求进行检验，这些模板针对七个受保护群体以完全相同的方式实例化，唯一变化的只有身份词。四个LLM分类器的平衡准确率均超过0.95，然而在完全相同的模板内，其中两个分类器漏检针对女性的仇恨言论的比率明显高于针对其他群体的相同言论（超额假阴性率分别为8.3和4.4个百分点），这一差距最早在2021年针对微调分类器的研究中被报告。我们展示了构念是如何发生偏移的：通过比较每个模板内的推理依据，我们发现模型会对其他群体援引受保护群体身份，但对针对女性（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过仅替换身份词的对照模板实验发现，尽管LLM仇恨言论分类器总体准确率超过0.95，但部分模型对针对女性的仇恨言论漏检率显著更高，且对完全相同的句子因身份不同而采用不同的判定构念，首次在LLM时代揭示了其测量非不变性问题。
en_tdlr: Using identity-swapped templates where only the group term varies, the study shows that despite balanced accuracy above 0.95, some LLM hate speech classifiers disproportionately miss hateful statements about women and invoke different constructs for identical sentences, revealing measurement non-invariance.
